A globalist agenda to destroy the family is the charge at the center of this Tucker Carlson episode. Carlson argues that powerful institutions push policies that weaken marriage, lower birth rates, and separate children from parents. He presents the pattern as a plan, not a series of accidents.

The episode works through the policies and cultural shifts Carlson blames, from education to public health. He then turns to escape: how families can protect their own lives against the pressure. Stories and examples carry the warning more than charts. Alarmed and watchful viewers get the host's darkest charge yet, with his way out.
